leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Create a DialogService that accepts a TemplateRef and renders it as an overlay using ViewContainerRef.createEmbeddedView()
Return a Subject from the open() method and complete it with true/false when the user confirms or cancels
Build a backdrop overlay using CDK Overlay with positionStrategy set to GlobalPositionStrategy for centred display
Implement Escape key dismissal using @HostListener('document:keydown.escape') on the dialog service or overlay component
Add ARIA attributes (role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby) and trap focus within the dialog for accessibility
Animate the dialog entrance and exit using Angular Animations with the :enter and :leave states
Call the dialog from a table row's delete button and chain the returned Observable with switchMap to the actual delete HTTP request
